review_description: The sales was very straight forward. Was happy with the price.Installation  took months to get done. Was meant to go on roof but ended up in a garage instead which is fine, if they tilled the panels, that would have been great. When told by one of the people doing the installation that beggars can't be choosers. When I told the customer service this they couldn't can less. Then told I needed to pay more for the system as they had to put another part on. So I would say DONT GO ANYWHERE NEAR MYSOLAR.
Solar not working call them every day this week and still no reply on when they will come and fix it.

When our system was not working properly after only four years we contacted My Solar who passed us onto Chromagen who eventually sent someone out to replace the inverter. However as no one was sent to actually check the system, the inverter, which cost US $150 in labour to replace, was not the problem so I contacted a local solar expert, Solargain, if anyone wants to get a solar power system, who took less than five minutes to find that a bank of eight panels were not working, and within an hour had it repaired. At a cost, again to US of $165. Now I am trying to get some of that back from Chromagen but they don't even have the courtesy to reply to my emails and phone calls. But they were quick to organise a quote for a new system.They won't even publish this response.

Only one of the solar dealers out of the two supplied emailed me with a quote. The other did not make contact! I did not proceed because I required a three Kw system and they only went to a one and a half.There are a lot of names out there who are getting involved in Solar so it pays to do a bit of research and compare what they are suppling ie. does the inverter have a five or ten year warranty and is the frame marine grade. How long is the installation warranty Most of the panels seem to be made in China but they all carry the same "performance" warranty of twenty five years. What happens if the dealer is not around then; can you still get warranty from the manufacture? I did find quite a big difference between some quotes for basically the same product( approx $5000) so shop around. I am still waiting for my system to be installed so time will tell if I have made the right choice. What I liked about Mysolar was they only required a ten percent deposit and then only fifty percent on competion. The rest once you are satisfied all is working correctly. Having said all that and once you have done your homework you have to just go for it and trust all is good!
Getting a reply from a supplier was difficult.

A slightly lower price and interest free finance were the deciding factors in selecting MySolar (although the salesman was also very helpful). So, thanks you for your assistance, and sory we couldn't do the business woth your people.  I must say that your aid and that of your contractor  was of decided usefulness in what is somewhat of a technical 'black hole' (and I'm a Professional Engineer, so goodness knows how non-technical people cope).Again, thanks for your assistance

My solar gave me the same watt output of the other 3 company's i got quoted and the same out put and product warranty the matched everything and they quoted me $3000.00 cheaper so i got 2 systems for both my homes, there service was 5 start i could not fault them.
